symptoms: Water-soaked lesions on leaf margins turning yellow-white and drying from tip inward
management: Use resistant varieties, avoid excess nitrogen, ensure field sanitation and balanced water management; consult an expert for approved bactericides.

symptoms: Diamond/spindle shaped grey-centered lesions with brown margins on leaves, neck rot at panicle base
management: Use resistant varieties, avoid dense nursery, balanced nitrogen; fungicidal seed treatment as advised by an agricultural officer.

symptoms: Dark water-soaked patches on leaves and stems with white fungal growth under humid conditions, fruit rot
management: Improve field drainage and air circulation, remove infected debris, use certified disease-free seedlings; fungicide only under expert guidance.

symptoms: Yellowing and wilting of lower leaves progressing upward, vascular browning inside stem
management: Practice crop rotation, use resistant/tolerant varieties, avoid waterlogging, solarize nursery soil before sowing.

symptoms: White powdery fungal growth on upper leaf surface, leaf curling and premature drying
management: Ensure good airflow between plants, avoid excess nitrogen, remove heavily infected leaves; sulfur-based fungicide only per label/expert advice.

symptoms: Yellowing of older leaves, splitting of pseudostem base, plant collapse
management: Use tissue-culture disease-free planting material, avoid waterlogged soil, do not replant bananas in infected fields for several years.

symptoms: Upward/downward curling of leaves, stunted growth, reduced fruiting
management: Control whitefly vector with sticky traps and recommended practices, remove infected plants early, use virus-tolerant varieties.

symptoms: Irregular yellow mosaic patches on leaves, stunted pods
management: Sow tolerant varieties, manage whitefly populations, remove volunteer/alternate host plants near field borders.
